outcome: The Experiment workspace module is split into tested parts (#554 complete)
owner_impact: Nothing changes on screen. This last slice moves every database read and write of the Experiment workspace (loading, autosaving, saving revisions, moving, sharing, copying, creating) behind named functions with 13 tests that check the exact queries. #554 is now complete. The workspace module went from 2,248 to 1630 lines. Its rules now live in five tested modules (labels, status, location and switching, database access, plus the earlier revision rules), with 41 new behaviour tests across slices 2–5. Test now: yes, a short check of the whole workspace. Sign in, open one of your Experiments, edit and save a revision, move it to another collection, share it read-only and revoke the share, use Save as new, then reload the page: your Experiment should reopen.

next.text: Next is #560: a small state module so the simulation display and speed meter stop reading on-screen text (the first stage of the 'with review' step of the plan). #560 waits for the owner's review before it starts.

technical_evidence: New web/src/registry/data.js: 22 named database operations (working copies, revisions, lists, reads, create/copy/move, sharing), with errors and messages unchanged.
registry-ui-v3.js calls them in the same places and order; only sign-in/out and the live revision subscription still touch the client directly (1,756 → 1630 lines).

New web/tests/registry-data.test.mjs: 13 behaviour tests against a recording fake client. Planted changes (move without the owner filter, discard without the one-row check, shared order lost, shares without shared_by) are each caught.

Differential check: the 22 data-touching workspace functions from before and after, run against the same recording fake database, produced identical queries, calls, state, results and errors across 1,540 runs (success, error, empty, zero-count and duplicate responses). Planted changes produced 11 to 163 differences.
Retired only the source-text query assertions now covered (39 lines in 14 test files), replaced by checks that the workspace uses the named operations. 660 tests pass.
Style comparison of the built Lab identical to the slice 4 build at all four viewports.
